summary.text: Brendon Morris Hartley (Palmerston North, Nueva Zelanda; 10 de noviembre de 1989) es un piloto de automovilismo neozelandés. Fue piloto de la Scuderia Toro Rosso en Fórmula 1 en 2017 y 2018. Ha sido cinco veces campeón del Campeonato Mundial de Resistencia de la FIA, en 2015 y 2017 con Porsche, y en 2022, 2023 y 2026 con Toyota Gazoo Racing, siendo el piloto con más títulos de la competición —igualado con Sébastien Buemi—. Fue ganador de las 24 Horas de Le Mans en 2017, 2020 y 2022, segundo en 2015, 2021 y 2023, y tercero en 2026.

summary.text:
Clayton Hugh Everett Green (born May 19, 1997) is an American professional stock car racing driver. He currently competes part-time in the NASCAR Truck Series, driving various trucks for Team Reaume.

Born and raised in Marble Falls, Texas, Green began racing in his local state of Texas in go-karts at the age of four. He transitioned to bandolero racing and legend car racing in the following years, racing nationwide. Starting in 2015, Green made a brief stint in NASCAR-sanctioned regional touring series, beginning with the West Series in 2015 before transferring to the East Series the following year. A crash in the early parts of 2016 caused Green to pause his racing career for two years due to financial hardships. Green resumed racing in 2019, racing in local racing divisions. In 2024, Green returned to racing in NASCAR in the nationally-touring third-tier NASCAR Truck Series on a part-time basis; in the following two years, Green expanded his schedule in the Truck Series to expand approval to various styles of racetracks on NASCAR's calendar.

Hideki Yamauchi (山内英輝, Yamauchi Hideki; born 24 October 1988) is a Japanese professional racing driver who currently competes in Super GT for R&D Sport. Alongside teammate Takuto Iguchi, he was champion of the 2021 Super GT Series in the GT300 class.

Richard Lynn "Ricky" Stenhouse, Jr. (Olive Branch, Mississippi; 2 de octubre de 1987) es un piloto de automovilismo, que desde el año 2020 conduce el Chevrolet No. 47 para JTG Daugherty Racing en la Copa NASCAR, habiendo obtenido 3 victorias, 14 top 5, dos pole positions y ganador de la Daytona 500 2023. Ha resultado campeón en 2011 y en 2012 de la NASCAR Nationwide Series, donde disputó 108 carreras, donde logró 8 victorias, 40 top 5, y 8 poles.

Morris Schuring (born 20 February 2005) is a Dutch racing driver currently competing in the LMGT3 category of the FIA World Endurance Championship with Manthey EMA. He is notable for being part of the first line-up to win the LMGT3 class at the 24 Hours of Le Mans race in 2024.

summary.text: Yohan Rossel (Nimes, Francia, 13 de febrero de 1995) es un piloto de rally francés que actualmente compite en el WRC 2 a bordo de un Lancia Ypsilon HF Rally2 del equipo PH Sport.

Ryan Ian Thomas Wood (born 4 December 2003) is a New Zealand racing driver from Wellington, New Zealand. He is currently competing in the Supercars Championship with Walkinshaw TWG Racing, driving the No. 2 Toyota GR Supra.
